name: loop
description: Loop — enterprise project management & team collaboration platform (DevFusion 4.0 PS-5)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @loop/db && npm run build --workspace @loop/api && npm run build --workspace @loop/web
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @loop/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @loop/web
